title: users
description: Per-user state across the whole bot: aliases, lastseen, optouts, blocks, supporter status. Created on first sighting in src/handlers/listener/update-user.js.

userid.description: Twitch user id (immutable; primary lookup key)

aliases.description: Every login this user has ever had (appended on rename)

currAlias.description: Current Twitch login (kept in sync via user-update event)

lsChannel.description: Channel where the user was last seen

firstSeen.description: Unix seconds of first message (added on newer docs)

optouts.description: commandNames of optoutable commands the user can't be targeted by (!optout / !optin). Checked with fb.utils.isOptedOut

optoutOwnChannel.description: When true, !lastseen/!stalk hide that this user is the broadcaster

blocks.description: Per-command block lists controlled by the user, keyed by commandName. Checked with fb.utils.isOptedOut

remind.description: Twitch user ids the user has blocked from sending them reminders

connections.description: Linked third-party accounts / saved per-user settings. Initialized to {} on user creation; sub-keys are added on demand by the relevant !set commands. Replaces the legacy `weather`, `lastfm`, `letterboxd` collections.

weather.description: Saved weather location, used by !weather and !time. Mirrors the legacy `weather` collection.

secret.description: When true, the location is hidden from other users' weather lookups

lastfm.description: Last.fm / Stats.fm linkage, used by !song and friends. Mirrors the legacy `lastfm` collection.

lastfm_user.description: Last.fm username, or null when only Stats.fm is set

statsfm_user.description: Stats.fm username, or null when not linked

use_statsfm.description: When true, prefer Stats.fm over Last.fm for lookups

letterboxd.description: Letterboxd account linkage. Mirrors the legacy `letterboxd` collection.

letterboxd_user.description: Letterboxd username (the path segment after letterboxd.com/)

isPlus.description: Set by !setplus on supporters of R$10+

lastSupportDate.description: Unix seconds of most recent supporter status assignment

totalDonated.description: Cumulative donated amount as recorded by !setplus

plusMonths.description: Total months subbed to leafyzito (ivr cumulative, not streak). Kept when a sub lapses

plusBadge.description: Plus tier badge id (sub, sub3m, sub6m, sub12m, sub24m) derived from plusMonths; served by /plus

plusTierCheckedAt.description: Unix seconds of the last successful ivr subage lookup, set by sync-plus-users

msgCount.description: Legacy per-channel message counters carried over from the Python bot. Not written by this repo.
